answer: Bitcoin’s stake slashing maps cleanly here: each agent bonds scarce reputation tokens, while validators stake too and compare signed behavior histories. When quorum proves an identity duplicated, every clone’s bond is slashed and rewards frozen, making wallet multiplication costly. Like a lotus climbing from a nadir on one rooted stem, trust rests on continuity; like karst filtering runoff, attestations separate real channels from duplicate conduits. Attackers burn stake per clone.
